speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have been experiencing episodic cough and shortness of breath; to help me understand your condition better, how long have these symptoms been occurring?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old female. The patient reports a 1-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath. The cough is nonproductive and worsens when climbing stairs and at night. She experienced fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma (likely exercise-induced or nocturnal variant). The patient is a 59-year-old female with a 1-month history of nonproductive cough and dyspnea triggered by exertion and occurring at night. Given her history of upper respiratory infection 8 weeks ago, this presentation is highly suggestive of post-viral asthma or reactive airway disease. I will proceed with a chest X-ray to rule out other pathologies and confirm the clinical picture.
